name: Product Analytics & Event Tracking
description: Product Analytics & Event Tracking standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-ANALYTICS applies.

rules.title: Define an event taxonomy before instrumentation
rules.detail: Events use stable names, documented business meaning, owner and property schema; avoid ad hoc per-screen naming.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define an event taxonomy before instrumentation.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define an event taxonomy before instrumentation.

rules.title: Track outcomes, not every interaction by default
rules.detail: Instrument events that answer product or operational questions and avoid unnecessary collection that adds privacy and cost risk.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Track outcomes, not every interaction by default.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Track outcomes, not every interaction by default.

rules.title: Do not send secrets or unnecessary PII in analytics
rules.detail: Analytics payloads must exclude credentials, tokens and sensitive content; PII requires an approved purpose and privacy basis.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Do not send secrets or unnecessary PII in analytics.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Do not send secrets or unnecessary PII in analytics.

rules.title: Make event delivery tolerant of offline and duplicate behavior
rules.detail: When analytics reliability matters, define batching, retry, ordering and deduplication expectations without blocking the user flow.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Make event delivery tolerant of offline and duplicate behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Make event delivery tolerant of offline and duplicate behavior.

rules.title: Version event property changes safely
rules.detail: Additive changes are preferred; removed or redefined properties require consumer review and migration.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Version event property changes safely.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Version event property changes safely.

rules.title: Validate analytics in test and release workflows
rules.detail: Verify representative events and properties in non-production or debug tooling before release and monitor unexpected volume/schema drift.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Validate analytics in test and release workflows.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Validate analytics in test and release workflows.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-ANALYTICS applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Product Analytics & Event Tracking to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Product Analytics & Event Tracking is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Product Analytics & Event Tracking failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
